messages:
jess: customer reported parser errors when using structured_output (json_mode=array) — their client gets "Unexpected key 'txnMeta'" from our response parser. Happens intermittently across multiple requests :eyes:
vikram: do we have a raw response sample and the original request? did this start after last runtime deploy?
jess: pasted minimal repro below (sanitized). request: 
```
POST /v1/complete 
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd-std-2",
  "structured_output": { "json_mode": "array", "schema": { /* schema expects items with id, amount */ } },
  "prompt": "generate txns"
}
```
response snippet we got (broken JSON returned by API streaming):
```json
[
  {"id":"t_100","amount":120.5},
  {"id":"t_101","amount":45.0,"txnMeta":{"region":"eu"}},
  {"amount":99.0,"id":"t_102"}
]
```
jess: client is strict and fails on the txnMeta key (they expected only id+amount). they also got a stream parse failure occasionally when the stream split happened between tokens — looks like metadata injection landed inside an item instead of outside the array.
vikram: can you confirm this started after the 2026-03-15 runtime patch? there's a streaming boundary change in the rollout notes. eli — any oncall context?
eli: I saw a similar symptom last night — streaming prefix KV caching + billing-tag injection can produce extra tokens if tagging runs mid-item. suspect commit rwd-infer/runtime@a7f9c3c changed where we emit per-request metadata. rolling back that change fixed one customer previously.
vikram: repro steps requested for eng: jess, paste a curl that reproduces with streaming mode and attach small timeout so it reliably triggers chunking. also include the exact model/version and a copy of the raw bytes from the connection (not pretty-printed).
jess: curl we used:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-std-2@2026-03-15","structured_output":{"json_mode":"array","schema":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["id","amount"]}}},"prompt":"emit 20 txns"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete > raw.bin
```
then we saw occasional "Unexpected key 'txnMeta'" when piping raw.bin through jq -R -s . | jq fromjson.
eli: thanks — that'll trigger the streaming chunk boundary. adding eng-runtime to triage. possible quick mitigation: set structured_output.stream_consistency: "item-aligned" (server-side) to avoid mid-item metadata insertion — will that work as a short-term customer suggestion?
jess: customer cannot change their client easily. asked if we can provide a temp header toggle to disable billing-tag injection for their tenant.
vikram: ops: can we scope a toggled rollback of the metadata-injection change for that tenant? if not, revert globally while we patch. eli: I'll check whether we can gate the feature by tenant flag; if not, plan a hotfix to ensure injected metadata is emitted only at array boundaries.
support-bot: incident-created #INC-2026-314 — assigned to eng-runtime, priority P1 (customer-facing parsing failures).
jess: customer notified we are investigating and asked for eta. will update when eng confirms mitigation. :thumbsup:
